fields.source:
喷射烟雾打击低空敌人，还会落下孢子雨攻击地表。

<color=#3D1400>伤害：</color><color=red>40/1.5秒</color>
<color=#3D1400>特点：</color><color=red>烟雾仅对空，且会在范围内降下12发伤害10的孢子攻击地表的僵尸</color>
<color=#3D1400>融合配方：</color><color=red>大喷菇+三叶草</color>
fields.previous:
Emits fumes to strike flying enemies while also dropping rains of spores to pepper the ground.

<color=black>Damage: </color><color=#8B0000>40/1.5s</color>
<color=black>Special: </color><color=#8B0000> Flying plant. Fumes only hits aerial zombies. But each attack also drops 12 spores that deals 10 damage across its attack range. Hitting non-aerial zombies below.</color>

text_assets.source:
试试给磁性玉米投手融合铁桶或者时空碎片！
超时空玉米投手与超时空豌豆射手的组合能快速放逐僵尸，非常强！
text_assets.previous:

text_assets.english:
Try putting Iron Buckets and Chrono Cores on Kernel Morphs!
Vortex-pult has amazing synergy with Chrono Pea!

text_assets.source:
【本关手套无冷却】
磁性毁灭菇不立即爆炸，而是在与铁器融合后爆炸！
+铁桶：击杀僵尸获得铁桶补给      +玩偶匣：击杀僵尸释放爆炸      +时空碎片：控制随后放逐僵尸

text_assets.english:
The Glove has no CD in this level. Dormant-shroom does not explode until you feed it Metal Objects!
Doomplate-shroom gives a Bucket for every zombie killed!
Trade these to Solar Magnets for Sun or feed them to Mecha-nuts!
Doombox-shroom triggers a chain explosion with 1800 damage for every zombie killed!
Doomwarp-shroom stun-locks the surviving zombies for 4s!
